name: InterContinental Muscat
positioning: Beachfront resort on Qurum Beach in Muscat's diplomatic quarter, set in 20 acres of gardens with the Hajar Mountains in the distance
best_for: Travelers who want a beach base close to Muscat's Royal Opera House and Mutrah Souk
Families who want a kids program, pools and beach access

facts.text: The hotel is set along the shore in Muscat's diplomatic quarter and offers direct beach access.
The hotel has 20 acres of gardens, with the Hajar Mountains rising in the distance.
The scent of frankincense lingers in the air as guests step inside.
The hotel is moments from the Royal Opera House and Mutrah Souk.
Classic rooms have French windows and private balconies.
The Deluxe Suite has a separate living room, a king-size bedroom and floor-to-ceiling Arabian Sea views.
The massage suites overlook gardens and have an open sit-out after treatment.
The Palm Beach Club kids program includes group games, face painting, arts and crafts, movie screenings and age-appropriate video games.
The hotel's Clefs d'Or concierge team guides guests to souks and coastal paths.
Signature touches include Omani coffee at reception, a pillow menu and Byredo toiletries.
Trader Vic's has been at the hotel since 2000, set by Qurum Beach with views of the Sea of Oman.
Mynah's Edge serves Arabic cuisine in the open air beside the Sea of Oman.

highlights.text: Qurum Beach, with soft golden sand meeting the Arabian Sea, lies right outside the hotel.
Palm Beach Club has a sauna, floodlit tennis and padel courts, lagoon-style pools and beachside access.
The Royal Suite has a living room, two bedrooms and sea-facing views, and connects to a Junior Suite.
The Luxury Massage Suites include a Single Suite and a Couples Suite.
Rooms overlook the Sea of Oman, the Hajar Mountains, or lush greenery with pools.

considerations.text: Muscat International Airport is about 21 kilometers from the hotel.
